from google.cloud import monitoring_v3

        metric_name (str): The name of the metric to compare.
        resource_labels (dict, optional): Labels to filter by resource. Defaults to None.
        dimension_filters (list, optional): List of dimension filters to apply. Defaults to None.
        window (tuple, optional): Tuple of start and end datetime objects defining the time window. Defaults to None.

    Returns:
        dict: A dictionary containing the comparison results for each resource or dimension filter.
    """
    client = monitoring_v3.MetricServiceClient()

        start_time = end_time - timedelta(days=1)

    metric_descriptor.metric_kind = monitoring_v3.MetricDescriptor.MetricKind.VALUE

    metric_descriptor.metric_kind = monitoring_v3.MetricDescriptor.MetricKind.VALUE
